data.text: I hear you. I will keep family updates limited to the logistics scope you set.

prior_context.speaker: patient_marcus_reed
prior_context.text: Apixaban 5 milligrams twice a day, metoprolol tartrate 25 milligrams twice a day, lisinopril 10 milligrams every morning, and omeprazole 20 milligrams daily.

prior_context.speaker: nurse_jamison
prior_context.text: Have you taken anything over the counter for pain or colds?

prior_context.speaker: patient_marcus_reed
prior_context.text: I took ibuprofen a couple of times last week for shoulder pain before I remembered I probably should not with the blood thinner.

prior_context.speaker: nurse_jamison
prior_context.text: That is important. We will likely tell you to stop ibuprofen because it raises bleeding risk with apixaban.

prior_context.speaker: nurse_jamison
prior_context.text: Have you missed any doses of apixaban in the last month?

prior_context.speaker: patient_marcus_reed
prior_context.text: I have not missed any morning doses. I might have been late by a few hours last Monday night when I was changing locations, but I still took that pill before bed.

prior_context.speaker: nurse_jamison
prior_context.text: I will document that as possible delayed but not skipped Monday-night dose. Any completely missed doses in the last three weeks?

prior_context.speaker: patient_marcus_reed
prior_context.text: None that I remember. I know they were strict about not missing it before cardioversion.

prior_context.speaker: nurse_jamison
prior_context.text: Good. What about alcohol, supplements, or stimulants that could affect rhythm?

prior_context.speaker: patient_marcus_reed
prior_context.text: No energy drinks. I am focusing on recovery and do not want those details discussed with family.
